request: Refine the stiff buttons, category labels, product plaques, and lower typography while keeping the header aesthetic
title: Refine pie cabinet controls
purpose: Bring cabinet filters, product labels, and purchase bar into the storefront's antique visual language

files.purpose: Bring cabinet filters, product labels, and purchase bar into the storefront's antique visual language
files.previous_behavior: Bright rectangular filter buttons and cream product cards contrasted sharply with the dark cabinet; the selection bar used mostly uniform sans-serif type and a flat red add button.
files.new_behavior: Cabinet filters use a brass rule and active underline; product labels look like dark engraved plaques; the selection bar uses restrained Korean serif typography and a framed oxblood action. Responsive sizing and focus outlines remain available.
files.data_impact: None; presentation CSS only, with no data reads, writes, or schema changes.
files.access_control_impact: None; no role, permission, or authentication logic changed.
risks: The Google hosted serif font may fall back when unavailable, changing text widths slightly; narrow screen sizes may need further visual adjustment.
files.rollback: Revert this commit to restore the earlier CSS. No data compatibility steps apply because the change is presentation only.

production_safety.operational_data: No production operational data was read, created, updated, or deleted.
external_side_effects: None; local preview and screenshot checks only.

verification.command: Playwright Chromium screenshots at 1920x910 and 390x844 against local port 3101
verification.evidence: Visually checked cabinet controls, four plaques, bottom bar, and mobile fit.

verification.command: Playwright Chromium: select Cream filter and Blueberry pie at 390x844
verification.evidence: Filter aria-pressed became true and detail link changed to /pies/blueberry.

residual_risks: Serif font fallback can shift spacing when Google Fonts cannot load.
